title: Personal Checking: The Overdraft Item Fee Reviewed for Error and the Debit Behind It
content:
## Rule

The error review of Personal Checking overdraft item fees looks at one fee: the overdraft item fee most recently posted to the account. Any overdraft item fee posted before that one is judged under the general Personal Checking fee refund rules rather than here.

The debit that gave rise to the fee is the entry the fee names as its source item. Every question about the debit — its amount, and what would have happened to it — is asked about that entry and no other.

## Tracing chain

| Record | What it points to |
|---|---|
| latest overdraft item fee entry | its source item |
| that source item | the debit that was paid into overdraft and drew the fee |

## Hypothetical illustration

An account shows three overdraft item fees, posted on 3, 9 and 17 March. The fee of 17 March is the one reviewed here; it names a 212.40 USD debit card payment as its source item, so that payment is the debit examined. The fees of 3 and 9 March fall to the general refund rules.
